title: TOP.ai — development capacity
description: TOP.ai reports what a plot's encoded rules imply, and the derivation of every figure that says so. Regulatory validity is never assessed and never claimed.

title: Parking — TOP.ai
description: How the parking number is actually made: an assumed area factor first, a placed level second, and the gap between them measured rather than hidden.

title: What comes out — TOP.ai
description: The files the engine writes — the drawing, the model file, the workbook, the run as data and the report — and what each one carries. Every name on the page is read out of a file, and none of the files leaves before two gates are signed.

title: What it refuses — TOP.ai
description: Everything this engine will not do, opening with the refusals it performs at runtime. If you are looking for the overclaim, start here.

title: The engine — TOP.ai
description: Run a plot through the engine and watch each step refuse, assume or derive in the open.

title: Your work — TOP.ai
description: Every run this account authored, kept exactly as it was computed, with what governed it and what it assumed. No totals and no averages: a mean of two governing capacities from two plots is not a fact about anything.

title: Sign in — TOP.ai
description: Sign in to keep your runs exactly as they were computed. An account changes two things and reviews nothing: regulatory validity is never assessed, with an account or without one.

title: Create an account — TOP.ai
description: Create an account to keep your runs. It does not make a run reviewed, verified, approved or compliant, and the licence number it records is never checked against any registry.

title: Settings — TOP.ai
description: Your name, your licence and your password — and what each one does to a run you sign. The licence is recorded and never verified; this page says so where the number is typed.

title: Workspace — TOP.ai
description: A firm, the people in it and what each of them may do. Nothing here is verified by anybody: the name is a label its members chose, and a licence on a review is recorded and never checked.

title: An invitation — TOP.ai
description: The other end of a workspace invitation. The link works for one account and says nothing about why it was refused.

title: Deployment readiness — TOP.ai
description: What is not ready in this deployment, and the human action that would change each figure. Readiness, not uptime — nothing here monitors availability.
